request.title: Can the services page say "we track 700+ sources daily"?
request.why: It is a public claim about the business; the owner is accountable for it.
request.context: The tracker currently lists 740 sources, but about 200 have not returned data in 30 days.
request.rec_reason: Only active sources are defensible if a customer checks.

response.note: No numbers on public pages for now.
response.standing_rule: Never publish a metric on a public page unless a customer could verify it from the product itself.

ack.note: Removed the number from the page; the rule was added as a draft delegation rule for you to confirm.
